BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Rural Development, Agriculture, & Natural Resources.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning special antlerless deer hunting seasons.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to special antlerless deer hunting seasons; and adding a new section to chapter 77.32 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 77.32 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: The department shall allow a person age sixty-five or over to harvest either an antlerless mule deer or antlerless white-tailed deer during the modern firearm general white-tailed buck season in all game management units east of the crest of the Cascade mountains.
